entities.name: ledgerRead
entities.text: /-- Rev 6: the one ledger read, `(P diagnosis-context)`. `(P prepare-diagnosis)` and `(P production-readiness)` decide from it, before any injury is known. Order error 3: `route!` reads the ledger a second time (`(P route! :durable-ledger)`), and that read has no state here. A runtime that reads twice conforms only while the two reads agree. M6a is to make `route!` use the context's read. Rev 8 note: with one read, a stale context overwrites a ledger file that changed between the read and coordination's persist. That is the one-read design taken literally, and it is pinned by `route-decides-from-the-context-read-not-a-second-read` (futon2 `6dd147e6a`). Rev 12 anchor (futon2 `3fe0a2b6d`, futon3c `c16a86952`): `(P diagnosis-context {:durable-ledger :active-injuries})`. The map has no `:status`, so no status literal is the site. Since then `route!` takes `(:meta-diagnosis-context opts)` and reads the ledger itself only when it is given no context (`(P route! durable)`), so order error 3 no longer arises from `run-opportunity!`. -/

entities.name: retryClick
entities.text: /-- Rev 7: the start of a retry click. Its options carry `:meta-repair-retry` (`(S close-click! :meta-repair-retry)`): the child of a parent that ended `:awaiting-retry`, launched only after the parent click is durably complete. It makes no ledger read of its own and no diagnosis (`(not R run-opportunity! meta-self-heal/diagnosis-context)`). It carries the acceptance observation `:acceptance-retry-not-prepared` (#22), which is typed, not a state. Rev 12 anchor (futon2 `3fe0a2b6d`, futon3c `c16a86952`): `(S close-click! :meta-repair-retry)` sets the option, in the child `click!` it launches after the parent's release. In `run-opportunity!` the branch is `(R run-opportunity! retry)`, and its one site is the observation `(R run-opportunity! {:status :not-required :reason :meta-self-heal/acceptance-retry-not-prepared})`. -/

entities.name: transactionRetired
entities.text: /-- Rev 24 (futon2 `b463d85cc`, F31; packet M23L): the click's continuation after an author failure. The edge from `coordinationHeld` is taken only when every part of the guard in `(P route! run-attempt)`'s loop holds: the attempt is held, its reason is `:author-failed`, its ledger and transaction writes are both `:persisted`, the reload `store/load-durable-ledger` is `:loaded`, and the injury's active entry is `:reopened` (at attempt n+1, from the authored attempt n). The producing site is `(P retire-stale-transaction! :retired)`, called as `(P route! retire-stale-transaction!)` on the attempt-n transaction. Then `coordinator/prepare` builds attempt n+1 with `(P continued-work-order-options)` and the two bindings re-run: a transaction with both bindings valid is `routeEnacted` again (there is no separate prepared state; on the first pass `readinessReady` goes to `routeEnacted` the same way), no transaction is `preparationRefused`, and a binding that is not valid is `bindingRefused`. Both refusals carry `(P route! :continued-from)`. The pass is bounded by the ledger, not by the table (`retiredVisits_le_attemptBudget`). -/

entities.name: transactionRetireFailed
entities.text: /-- Rev 24 (F31): the retirement was refused, `(P retire-stale-transaction! :meta-self-heal/transaction-retire-failed)`, returned by `(P route! retire-stale-transaction!)` in two places: before the first prepare, when a resumed transaction belongs to an earlier attempt than the ledger's (from `readinessReady`), and in the continuation (from `coordinationHeld`, the refusal sibling of `transactionRetired`). The second carries `(P route! :continued-from)`, with the refused retirement's status and reason in its last entry. A terminal refusal. -/

entities.name: authorFailed
entities.text: /-- `(C coordinate :author-failed)`. Rev 21 (futon2 `4e7b31cdc`, F26): the hold is the click's disposition (`coordinationHeld`, then `terminalRecord`), but it is no longer the injury's end. Before holding, the author arm calls `(C coordinate ledger/append-retry-result)` with `:reason :author-failed` and the sealed failed receipt's pin as `:port-receipt-pin`, and `held!` carries that ledger. The ledger's latest entry is then `:reopened` at attempt n+1 from `:claimed`, or `:abandoned` with `(L append-retry-result :attempt-limit-exhausted)` (the same pin) when n+1 would exceed `:attempt-limit`; `(L allowed-predecessors :claimed)` admits both, and `(L state-defects :reopen/author-failure-evidence)` and `(L state-defects :abandonment/author-failure-evidence)` refuse them without the pin. Rev 23 (futon2 `fba25030a`, F31): the click does not stop there. `route!` runs the checkpoint loop as `(P route! run-attempt)` and loops over attempts. When an attempt is held `:author-failed` with both its ledger and transaction writes persisted, the ledger is reloaded, and if the injury's active entry is `:reopened` the same click goes on: `(P route! retire-stale-transaction!)` retires the attempt-n transaction (a refused retirement is the click's disposition), `prepare` builds attempt n+1 from the reloaded ledger with `(P continued-work-order-options)` (the three claim sessions suffixed `/attempt-` and the attempt number, because `(L state-defects :claim/session-not-fresh)` refuses a reused one), the diagnosis and acceptance bindings are re-run against the new transaction, and `run-attempt` runs again. The loop stops on any other result, or when the active entry is `:abandoned`; the ledger's `:attempt-limit` bounds it. `coordinationHeld` is where the click ends only when the last attempt of the loop is held; the attempts it moved past are listed in order in the disposition's `(P route! :continued-from)`, each with its attempt, reason and retired transaction. Rev 24 (packet M23L): the loop is in the state graph as the cycle `coordinationHeld → transactionRetired → routeEnacted`, with the refusals `transactionRetireFailed`, `preparationRefused` and `bindingRefused` reached from it (`ContinuationRefusal`); the attempts moved past are `ContinuedAttempt`s on the observation, and when both writes persisted but the loop did not go on, the held result says why (`ContinuationOutcome`). -/

entities.name: reopened
entities.text: /-- `:reopened` (via `ledger/append-retry-result`): the retry did not discharge. Rev 14 anchor (futon2 `43bb57fc7`; C, T and L unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(C coordinate ledger/append-retry-result)`, the `:else` arm of the retry receipt. The status is computed, `(get-in reopened [:entry :state])` (`(C coordinate "get-in reopened")`), and is `:reopened` when `(L append-retry-result :reopened)` takes its second arm. Rev 21 (futon2 `4e7b31cdc`, F26): this is the enacted path only, with predecessor `:enacted` and the retry's reason. The author arm of `coordinate` also appends a `:reopened` (or `:abandoned`) ledger entry, with predecessor `:claimed` and `:reason :author-failed` (`HeldReason.authorFailed`), but `coordinate` returns `:held` there, so it does not produce this closing status. `(L allowed-predecessors :claimed)` lists `:reopened` and `:abandoned` from both `:enacted` and `:claimed`, and `(L state-defects :reopen/reason-unexpected)` refuses an `:author-failed` reopen from `:enacted`, so the two paths cannot be confused in a valid ledger. Rev 23 (F31): the author arm's `:reopened` entry is consumed by the same click, whose continuation (`(P route! run-attempt)`) retires the attempt-n transaction and authors attempt n+1. Rev 24: that is the edge `coordinationHeld → transactionRetired`. -/

entities.name: abandoned
entities.text: /-- `:abandoned`: the attempt after this one would exceed the budget. Rev 14 anchor (futon2 `43bb57fc7`; C, T and L unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(C coordinate ledger/append-retry-result)`, the same computed status (`(C coordinate "get-in reopened")`), `:abandoned` when `(L append-retry-result :attempt-limit-exhausted)` takes its first arm. A second abandoned literal exists; it is `RetryNext.abandoned .retryBudgetSpent`, not this constructor: `(not C coordinate-queued-retry :retry-budget-spent)`. Rev 21: as for `reopened`, the author arm's `:abandoned :attempt-limit-exhausted` entry (predecessor `:claimed`, carrying `:port-receipt-pin`) is returned under `:held`, not as this closing status. Rev 23 (F31): that entry ends the click's continuation; the hold of that attempt is the click's disposition. -/

entities.name: awaitingRetry
entities.text: /-- `:awaiting-retry`: the retry port queued the retry click. The production retry port only persists and enqueues, so this is the closing status a production click is expected to reach. The M4a shape does not name it (finding). Rev 14 anchor (futon2 `43bb57fc7`; C, T and L unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(C coordinate-queued-retry :awaiting-retry)` returned by `coordinate` through its `(= :queued (:status retry-receipt))` arm, when `ledger/pending-requeue` finds nothing. -/

entities.name: retryInconclusive
entities.text: /-- Rev 8: the retry click ran but did not test the repair (`RetryClickOutcome.closing`). The injury is neither discharged nor reopened, and the transaction stays `:enacted` and active. Rev 14 anchor (futon2 `43bb57fc7`; C, T and L unchanged since `d0a890f22`): not a `coordinate` status. It is the retry click's `(T integrate :retry-inconclusive)` observation: the non-injury arm for every reason except a successful task outcome, `(not T classify :successful-task-outcome)`, and `(T append-other-injury-retry-observation :retry-inconclusive)`. -/

entities.name: reloadUnavailable
entities.text: /-- The reload did not return `:loaded`: `(P route! :meta-self-heal/reload-unavailable)`, with the durable's status beside it. Any reopened entry waits for a later click. -/

entities.name: entryNotReopened
entities.text: /-- The injury is active but its entry is not `:reopened`: `(P route! :entry-not-reopened)`, status `:not-continued`, with the entry. -/

entities.name: injuryNotActive
entities.text: /-- The injury is no longer active, for instance its last entry is `:abandoned` with `(L append-retry-result :attempt-limit-exhausted)`: `(P route! :injury-not-active)`, status `:not-continued`, with that last entry. -/

entities.name: transactionRetireFailed
entities.text: /-- `(P retire-stale-transaction! :meta-self-heal/transaction-retire-failed)` in the continuation. -/

entities.name: preparationRefused
entities.text: /-- `coordinator/prepare` gave no transaction for attempt n+1: `(P route! :meta-self-heal/preparation-refused)`, keeping the coordinator's result under `:prepare`: `(C prepare :coordinator/preparation-refused)` with its defects, or `(C prepare :coordinator/preparation-malformed)`. -/

entities.name: bindingRefused
entities.text: /-- A re-run binding was not valid, returned through `(P route! "if-not (= :valid (:status next-binding))")`; the reasons are those of `bindingRefused`: `(P diagnosis-transaction-binding :meta-self-heal/diagnosis-transaction-mismatch)`, `(P acceptance-transaction-binding :meta-self-heal/acceptance-transaction-mismatch)`, `(P acceptance-transaction-binding :meta-self-heal/acceptance-transaction-unadmitted)`. -/

entities.name: ledgerNotLoaded
entities.text: /-- The ledger did not load (`(= :loaded (:status durable))` fails). -/

entities.name: noEnactedEntry
entities.text: /-- No `:enacted` entry in the ledger. -/

entities.name: noAuthoredEntry
entities.text: /-- No `:authored` entry for the enacted injury and repair. -/

entities.name: fieldDiffers
entities.text: /-- One field of `:supplied` differs from `:expected`. -/

entities.name: successfulTaskOutcome
entities.text: /-- `:successful-task-outcome`: no failure kind, and an outcome in `(T successful-outcomes)`. The only outcome that tests the repair and passes. Rev 13 anchor (futon2 `9d3026e1a`, T unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(T classify :successful-task-outcome)`, the `non-injury-reason` arm for a nil failure kind and an outcome in `successful-outcomes`; `integrate` then appends `(T integrate :discharged)` for the enacted entry. -/

entities.name: sameInjury
entities.text: /-- `:injury` with the enacted entry's injury id: `(L append-retry-result)`. The retry failed for the same cause. Rev 13 anchor (futon2 `9d3026e1a`, T unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(T integrate ledger/append-retry-result)`, the arm `(= :enacted (:state previous))` with `(= (:retry-click previous) (:click-id classification))`; the transition is the computed `(get-in appended [:entry :state])`, so there is no keyword literal. -/

entities.name: otherInjury
entities.text: /-- `:injury` with a different injury id, and the record is ingested. Cited at futon2 `b5dd9269c` (M10b-4). `integrate` binds `other-injury-retry?` (`(T integrate "other-injury-retry?")`). If the different id is unknown, it opens a new injury (`(T integrate "nil? previous")`). If it is active, it appends a `:repeated-active-injury` observation (`(T integrate :repeated-active-injury)`). Either way it then appends the attributed `:retry-inconclusive` observation for the enacted entry through `(T append-other-injury-retry-observation)`. The enacted entry's state is untouched. Added in rev 8 (finding) and widened by the rev 8 review. Rev 11 split off the refused arms as `otherInjuryRefused`. Rev 13 anchor (futon2 `9d3026e1a`, T unchanged since `d0a890f22`), re-anchored in rev 16 to the call the function makes: `(T append-other-injury-retry-observation ledger/append-observation)` which appends the retry-inconclusive observation for the enacted entry. The function is called from `(T integrate)` on the `(nil? previous)` arm with transition `:open` and on the `ledger/active-states` arm with transition `:active-injury-retained`. -/

entities.name: otherInjuryRefused
entities.text: /-- Rev 11: `:injury` with a different injury id, and the record is refused, not ingested (at `b5dd9269c`). This happens when the different id is itself `:enacted` and this click is not its retry click (`:injury/retry-click-mismatch`), or when the different id is terminal (`:injury/terminal-history-requires-new-transaction`). `integrate` returns `{:status :refused}` with no ledger, so no observation is written and the pin stays un-ingested. It is a separate constructor, not an unobserved `otherInjury`, because the coordinator receives a refusal rather than an ingested record without an observation. Under the law it is still inconclusive for the enacted injury. Rev 13 anchor (futon2 `9d3026e1a`, T unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(T integrate :injury/retry-click-mismatch)`, `(T integrate :injury/terminal-history-requires-new-transaction)`. -/

entities.name: ordinarySelectionAbstention
entities.text: /-- `:ordinary-selection-abstention`: an abstention. Rev 13 anchor (futon2 `9d3026e1a`, T unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(T abstention-reason :ordinary-selection-abstention)`, the `:else` arm, reached from `classify` when the failure kind is `:abstained` and the route is configured. The `{:abstained :ordinary-selection-abstention}` entry of `explicit-non-injury-kinds` is never read for it: `classify` takes the `:abstained` branch first. -/

entities.name: evaluatedNoAction
entities.text: /-- `:evaluated-no-action` (`(T evaluated-no-action?)`): scored, and no action chosen. Rev 13 anchor (futon2 `9d3026e1a`, T unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(T abstention-reason :evaluated-no-action)`, guarded by `evaluated-no-action?` (`:policy-nondiscrimination` among the causes). -/

entities.name: partialFrontierContinuation
entities.text: /-- `:partial-frontier-continuation` (`(T partial-frontier-continuation?)`). Rev 13 anchor (futon2 `9d3026e1a`, T unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(T abstention-reason :partial-frontier-continuation)`, guarded by `partial-frontier-continuation?`. -/

entities.name: operatorCancelled
entities.text: /-- `:operator-cancelled`. Rev 13 anchor (futon2 `9d3026e1a`, T unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(T explicit-non-injury-kinds :operator-cancelled)`, read in `classify`'s `non-injury-reason`. -/

entities.name: declaredNoWork
entities.text: /-- `:declared-no-work`. Rev 13 anchor (futon2 `9d3026e1a`, T unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(T explicit-non-injury-kinds :declared-no-work)`, read in `classify`'s `non-injury-reason`. -/

entities.name: diagnosticOnly
entities.text: /-- `:diagnostic-only`. Rev 13 anchor (futon2 `9d3026e1a`, T unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(T explicit-non-injury-kinds :diagnostic-only)`, read in `classify`'s `non-injury-reason`. -/

entities.name: absentTerminalFailure
entities.text: /-- `:absent-terminal-failure`: no failure kind and no outcome. Rev 13 anchor (futon2 `9d3026e1a`, T unchanged since `d0a890f22`): `(T classify :absent-terminal-failure)`, the `non-injury-reason` arm for a nil failure kind and a nil outcome. -/

entities.name: recordUnreadable
entities.text: /-- Rev 9: the retry click left no record that can be read. Then nothing reaches `integrate`, and the entry stays `:enacted`. Absence is evidence of neither success nor failure, so this is inconclusive (the 2026-09-24 rule that absence must not read as a value). Rev 13 anchor (futon2 `9d3026e1a`, T unchanged since `d0a890f22`): no producing site in T for a retry that wrote no record: nothing is ingested. A record that exists but cannot be ingested stops before `integrate` at `(meta-injury-store ingest-record-file! :store/record-ingest-failed)` or at `read-one-form`'s non-`:read` result (that file has no tag), and a record that does not classify stops at `(T classify :terminal-record/malformed)`. Reading those as this constructor is my reading, not something the Lean states. -/

entities.name: attemptLimitExhausted
entities.text: /-- `:attempt-limit-exhausted`: the next authoring would exceed `:attempt-limit`. Rev 15 anchor (futon2 `5a066d9ab`; C and L unchanged since `aa3ec313b`): `(L append-retry-result :attempt-limit-exhausted)` reached through `(C coordinate ledger/append-retry-result)`. `validate-ledger`'s abandonment check (`(L state-defects :attempt-limit-exhausted)`) accepts it only at `attempt = limit`. -/

entities.name: retryBudgetSpent
entities.text: /-- Rev 9 (new, M10b): the re-queue budget for inconclusive retries is spent. A re-queue authors nothing, so it does not count against `:attempt-limit`. Rev 15 anchor (futon2 `5a066d9ab`; C and L unchanged since `aa3ec313b`): `(L append-requeue :retry-budget-spent)`, the arm where the entry's requeue count has reached the ledger's retry limit (`(L append-requeue :retry-limit)`), with the attempt carried over unchanged. `(C coordinate-queued-retry :retry-budget-spent)` returns it, after reading the appended entry's state (`(C coordinate-queued-retry :abandoned)`), before any retry port call. `validate-ledger` accepts it only when the requeue count equals the retry limit (`(L state-defects :retry-budget-spent)`). -/

entities.name: queued
entities.text: /-- A fresh retry click is queued for the same enacted entry. Rev 15 anchor (futon2 `5a066d9ab`; C and L unchanged since `aa3ec313b`): `(C coordinate-queued-retry ledger/append-requeue)`, on the arm where `(C coordinate-queued-retry ledger/pending-requeue)` finds the attributed observation, and then `(L append-requeue :enacted)`, a new enacted entry with a new retry click. The entry's fields: `attempt` is the ledger's attempt, copied from the previous entry (`(L append-requeue :attempt)`); `requeues` is the ledger's requeue count, read and written incremented (`(L append-requeue "inc requeues")`). On the `recur`, C reads that count back (`(C coordinate-queued-retry :requeues)`) and, being positive, calls the retry port with the requeue ordinal (`(C coordinate-queued-retry "requeue-phase")`). The queued click then ends the same way as `awaitingNothingQueued`: the new entry has no observation yet, so `coordinate` returns the awaiting-retry status. In the code the two constructors differ by the appended entry and the port call, not by the status. -/

entities.name: awaitingNothingQueued
entities.text: /-- The transaction ends `:awaiting-retry`, and nothing is queued. Rev 15 anchor (futon2 `5a066d9ab`; C and L unchanged since `aa3ec313b`): `(C coordinate-queued-retry :awaiting-retry)` is the arm where `(C coordinate-queued-retry ledger/pending-requeue)` returns nil. -/

entities.name: discharged
entities.text: /-- Rev 15 anchor (futon2 `5a066d9ab`; C and L unchanged since `aa3ec313b`): no producing site of its own; see `ClosingStatus.discharged`, which `next` passes through. -/

entities.name: reopened
entities.text: /-- Rev 15 anchor (futon2 `5a066d9ab`; C and L unchanged since `aa3ec313b`): no producing site of its own; see `ClosingStatus.reopened`, which `next` passes through. -/

entities.name: abandoned
entities.text: /-- Rev 15 anchor (futon2 `5a066d9ab`; C and L unchanged since `aa3ec313b`): no producing site of its own; see the two `AbandonReason` constructors, which carry the sites. -/

entities.name: carriedTransaction
entities.text: /-- `(P carried-bindings-observation :carried-transaction)`: the transaction's work order names an active injury; its pins fill the options the caller did not supply. The map has no `:status`, so it is no site; the call is `(R run-opportunity! meta-self-heal/carried-bindings-observation)`. -/

entities.name: noActiveInjury
entities.text: /-- `(P carried-bindings-observation {:status :absent :reason :no-active-injury})`. -/

entities.name: transactionInjuryNotActive
entities.text: /-- `(P carried-bindings-observation {:status :absent :reason :transaction-injury-not-active})`. -/

entities.name: noTransaction
entities.text: /-- `(P carried-bindings-observation {:status :absent :reason :no-transaction})`. -/

entities.name: retryClick
entities.text: /-- A retry click reads no context and carries nothing: `(R run-opportunity! {:status :absent :reason :retry})`. Not `CoordinationPhase.retry`. -/
